en.topic_title: Ex-husband, in-laws accused of murdering Hong Kong model Abby Choi appear in court
en.topic_summary:
The ex-husband and in-laws accused of murdering Hong Kong model and influencer Abby Choi appeared in court on Wednesday, in a gruesome case that has sent shockwaves through the city.



Abby Choi in 2022. Photo: Abby Choi, via Instagram.



Choi, an influencer with more than 140,000 followers on Instagram, had shared photos from Paris Fashion Week just days before she was killed in 2023.



Police discovered parts of the 28-year-old’s dismembered body at a house in suburban Hong Kong.&nbsp
